# **CONTRACT FOR E-APPLICATION DEVELOPMENT**
**Estech Solutions** ("Developer") and **[Client Name]** ("Client"), collectively referred to as the "Parties," enter into this Agreement effective as of **[Date]**.

---

## **1. PARTIES**
**Developer:** Estech Solutions
**Address:** [Your Business Address]
**Contact:** [Your Email/Phone]

**Client:** [Client’s Company Name]
**Address:** [Client’s Business Address]
**Contact:** [Client’s Email/Phone]

---

## **2. PROJECT SCOPE**
The Developer agrees to design, develop, and deliver a **Web Application (E-AW App)** and an **AI Chatbot** for the Client, as further described below:

### **2.1 Web Application (E-AW App)**
- A **custom business website** tailored to the Client’s needs.
- Features:
  - Responsive design (mobile & desktop compatible).
  - User-friendly interface (UI/UX optimized).
  - Secure login/registration system.
  - Integration with payment gateways (if required).
  - SEO-friendly structure.
  - Admin panel for content management.

### **2.2 AI Chatbot**
- A **conversational AI chatbot** embedded in the E-AW App.
- Capabilities:
  - Natural Language Processing (NLP) for customer queries.
  - 24/7 automated responses.
  - Escalation to human support if needed.
  - Integration with existing business systems (CRM, databases, etc.).

### **2.3 Deliverables**
- **Final Web Application** (fully functional, tested, and deployed).
- **AI Chatbot** (trained on Client’s data, if provided).
- **Source code** (escrow or transfer upon full payment).
- **Documentation** (technical & user manuals).
- **Training session** (1 hour for Client’s team on app management).

---

## **3. PAYMENT TERMS**
### **3.1 Total Cost: $2,000,000.00 (USD)**
- **Payment Schedule:**
  - **50% ($1,000,000) upon signing this Agreement** (non-refundable deposit).
  - **30% ($600,000) upon completion of the E-AW App UI/

title: proposal to upgrade uba bank app
content:
ESTECH SOLUTIONS

PROPOSAL TO UPGRADE THE UBA BANK APP
Enhancing Digital Banking Experience through Feature Expansion

Prepared for: United Bank for Africa (UBA)
Prepared by: Estech Solutions
Date: [Insert Date]
Document Version: 1.0

---

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

Estech Solutions is pleased to present this proposal to United Bank for Africa (UBA) for the strategic upgrade and enhancement of the existing UBA mobile banking application. Our goal is to deliver a modern, secure, and user-centric digital banking platform that not only meets current customer expectations but also supports UBA’s strategic vision for digital transformation and customer engagement.

Through the addition of advanced features—such as real-time transaction tracking, personalized financial insights, AI-driven chat support, and improved biometric authentication—we aim to elevate the app’s functionality, usability, and security. This upgrade will position UBA at the forefront of digital banking innovation in Africa while driving customer retention, satisfaction, and revenue growth.

This proposal outlines the scope, benefits, technical approach, timeline, and investment required for this comprehensive app upgrade.

---

1. INTRODUCTION

1.1 Purpose of the Proposal
This document formalizes Estech Solutions’ offer to enhance the existing UBA Bank mobile application by integrating new features that improve user experience, increase operational efficiency, and strengthen competitive advantage.

1.2 Background
UBA Bank’s mobile application serves millions of customers across Africa, supporting core banking functions such as account management, fund transfers, bill payments, and card controls. While robust, the app currently lacks several modern features that today’s digitally savvy users expect. Additionally, enhanced security and personalization are increasingly demanded by regulators and customers alike.

1.3 Estech Solutions’ Expertise
Estech Solutions specializes in custom software development, mobile application design, and digital transformation for financial institutions. With over [X] years of experience serving leading banks and fintechs in Nigeria and across Africa, we bring deep technical knowledge, industry best practices, and a proven track record of delivering secure, scalable, and user-friendly solutions.

---

2. PROJECT OVERVIEW

2.1 Project Title
UBA Mobile Banking App Enhancement – Feature Expansion & Performance Optimization

2.2 Objectives
- Enhance user experience with intuitive design and faster navigation
- Introduce AI-powered financial insights and budgeting tools
- Strengthen security with advanced biometric
